decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No part of the roof of the extension shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 6 - It is considered that the proposed single-storey rear extension, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having regard for the characteristics of the site, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property, and would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers. The development is therefore in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 and the Council's Residential Guidelines (July 2002).
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
